features: The ZEB-Thump 700 portable Bluetooth speaker produces a robust 120W output, ensuring that its sound can be physically felt, allowing you to maintain the vibe without any interruptions
Take the ZEB-Thump 700 with you wherever you go, thanks to its convenient carry handle and wheels, making transportation easy and hassle-free.
The speaker is equipped with dual potent full-range drivers measuring 25.4 cm each, ensuring outstanding acoustics.
To kick-start the party instantly, just rise and dance alongside the speaker's vibrant and dynamic RGB LED lights.
This speaker is equipped with a built-in rechargeable battery and allows you to take it anywhere as you can enjoy the music for up to 7 hours.

Connect your USB pen drive/mSD to the speaker to start listening to your whole, priceless MP3 song library. By connecting the smartphone to this speaker wirelessly via BT v5.0, you can now enjoy your favorite songs. The wired connection with the speaker can be done with the AUX input. The speaker also comes with an FM radio.

Keep the karaoke party alive wherever you venture with the wireless microphone included with the speaker. The speaker also has dual 6.3mm microphone input and guitar input, you can also connect two wired microphones for singing.
Utilizing its distinctive TWS feature, you can pair another Thump 700 speaker with this one, enabling you to enjoy karaoke whenever the mood strikes.
Attach a microphone to the speaker using the wired connection that is supported by the 2 x 6.3mm mic input and a guitar input.
